Event details

One day, two rounds, three movements.

Each movement builds on the one before: Round 1 qualifies teams through portfolio engineering, and Round 2 challenges qualifiers to solve revealed problem statements with autonomous agents.

I
Movement 1 · Round 1 Challenge

From Prompt to Portfolio

Teams build and deploy responsive portfolios from design references and submit them to the portal. Round 1 winners are glorified and their portfolios become spectacle benchmarks for everyone.

Round 1 · ~3 hrs (proposed)
II
Movement 2 · Round 2 Transition

From Chatbot to Agent

Understanding autonomous agents, visual workflows in n8n, and revealing the Round 2 problem statements on the website (unified statement if qualifiers are minimal).

Round 2 Prep · ~2 hrs (proposed)
III
Movement 3 · Round 2 Hackathon

Conduct Your Own AI Agent

Round 1 qualifiers build and conduct multi-agent prototypes to solve the revealed problem statement, stress-testing workflows and presenting live demonstrations.

Round 2 Finale · Hackathon sprint
Format2 Rounds · 1-Day Event
Round 1: PortfoliosBuild, deploy & submit to portal; top portfolios glorified as benchmarks.
Round 2: HackathonProblem statements revealed for qualifiers (single statement if minimal qualifiers).
Adaptive StructureMovements run flexibly across the day with dynamic qualification pacing.
